example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজটি ফি-রোজ অনেক সময় নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: This job takes a lot of time every day.
history: Derived from Persian/Urdu terms 'fi roz' (per day) and 'fi sal' (per year), incorporated into Bengali during the medieval period under Muslim influence.
note: These are more adverbial phrases than full idioms, commonly used in spoken and written Bengali for expressing periodicity.
